proposals.evidence: DEDR3376(a) explicitly gives Tamil tūṅku ‘sleep, slumber’ as well as hang/swing. Survey tūngə matches this stem with its voiced stop and final central vowel retained. The annotation3276 is an unrelated sobbing entry, and3291 tuñcu is only a questioned broader comparison. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
